## Why it made the list

Asking COP 590,000,000 (about €165,200) for a two-storey house of about 120 m² in a gated residential complex in Rodadero Reservado, the quiet area north of El Rodadero beach in Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast. It has just been fully remodelled in a modern style: a new kitchen with stone-look worktops and gas hob, glossy tiled floors, a steel-railed staircase and new bathrooms with glass showers. There are three bedrooms, the main one with its own bathroom and dressing area, a separate study and a guest toilet. Balconies look onto green hills, and the complex has a large shared pool. Maintenance fee not stated.
